name: IRON CROSS POKER
description: Iron Cross (also known as Criss-Cross or Church Poker) is a popular community-card poker variant played in 'dealer's choice' games. Five community cards are arranged in a cross pattern on the table. Each player receives two hole cards and must form the best five-card hand by combining their cards with either the vertical or horizontal line of the cross.

content.text: Iron Cross (also known as Criss-Cross or Church Poker) is a popular community-card poker variant played in 'dealer's choice' games. Five community cards are arranged in a cross pattern on the table. Each player receives two hole cards and must form the best five-card hand by combining their cards with either the vertical or horizontal line of the cross.
Developed as a variation of '7-Card Stud' and 'Texas Hold'em'. The unique cross layout adds a layer of spatial decision-making to the betting process.
Deal two hole cards face-down to each player. Arrange 5 community cards face-down in a cross (three horizontal, three vertical, sharing a middle card).

items.text: High-Low Iron Cross: Best hand on vertical splits the pot with best hand on horizontal.
Wild Cross: The center card is wild.
Double Cross: Two crosses are dealt, creating four possible paths.
